item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history and views from 105-step climb
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb offers panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean and Jupiter Inlet.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in United States
item.description: A WalletHub study released this month ranked Port St. Lucie as the 67th most stressed city in the nation, citing it as the 42nd most financially stressed city in America.

item.title: Aldi opens in Hobe Sound as shoppers face rising grocery costs
item.description: A new Aldi opened Thursday at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound, giving Martin County shoppers another option as grocery prices continue to strain family.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff in dramatic Wimbledon semifinal tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names ahead of August debut
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League unveiled the nicknames and logos of its four teams ahead of its inaugural season, with each team name inspired by pioneering women.

item.title: Park Vista Community High School football team targets state playoffs after strong finish
item.description: The Park Vista Community High School Cobras are building on late-season momentum after winning four of their last five games in 2025.

item.title: Florida families can save during 32-day back-to-school sales tax holiday starting July 20
item.description: Florida's annual back-to-school sales tax holiday runs from July 20 through Aug. 20, offering no sales tax on qualifying purchases including clothing, school supplies, and computers.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of maritime history with views of Indian River
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, provides visitors with panoramic views that include the Indian River, along with the Atlantic Ocean and Jupiter Inlet.
